name: Settlement Sub Total Calculated Tax 2
definition: Specifies the subtotal calculated tax applicable for this settlement.

CalculatedRate.name: Calculated Rate
CalculatedRate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of this tax, levy or duty.

BasisAmount.name: Basis Amount
BasisAmount.definition: Monetary value used as the basis on which this tax, levy or duty is calculated.

CalculatedAmount.name: Calculated Amount
CalculatedAmount.definition: Monetary value resulting from the calculation of this tax, levy or duty.

ExemptionReasonCode.name: Exemption Reason Code
ExemptionReasonCode.definition: Reason for tax exemption expressed as a code, if invoice or card transaction is out of tax processing.

ExemptionReasonText.name: Exemption Reason Text
ExemptionReasonText.definition: Reason for a tax exemption, if invoice or card transaction is out of tax processing.

TaxCurrencyExchange.name: Tax Currency Exchange
TaxCurrencyExchange.definition: If tax currency in tax calculation is different from invoice currency, then applied exchange rate is given in this message structure.
